question: Who among the following was appointed as a full-time member of SEBI in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashwani Bhatia.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Shri Ashwani Bhatia **took charge as Whole Time Member, of the Securities, and Exchange Board **of India, in Mumbai, today.
 
• Prior to this assignment, Shri Bhatia held the position of** Managing Director at the State Bank of India.**
 
• Shri Bhatia will handle the Department of ** Debt and Hybrid Securities (DDHS).**
 
• Shri B. Rajendran takes charge as Executive Director, SEBI in November 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
 

 Ajay Seth
 
 
Shri Ajay Seth is currently serving as Secretary of Economic Affairs

 
 
 

 M Rajeshwar Rao
 M. Rajeshwar Rao was appointed Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India in October 2020.
 
 

 Dr. V Ravi Anshuman
 IIM professor V Ravi Anshuman a part-time member in the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
